title: Power Apps: Use Power Platform connectors in generative pages
description:
Makers can bring data from Power Platform connectors into generative pages. After creating and authenticating a connection and adding a connection reference to the environment, you select the connector data and describe how the generated page should use it. Connector data can be incorporated while working in the Maker Studio generative page designer or through the generative pages AI plugin.

Availability

Field
Value

Release Channel
Not applicable

Version
Gen page v302

Applies to
Model-driven apps

Feature Scope
